name: Alienist
body:
You summon your allies from alien worlds and dimensions.

Prerequisite(s): Augmented Summoning, caster level 11+

Benefit(s): Creatures you conjure with any summon spell gain the frightful presence universal monster rule and immunity to mind-affecting effects. In addition, each such creature gains a tentacle as a secondary natural attack with appropriate damage for a creature of its size.
